source_direct_findings: Inspect EvalSpec persists eval/task/run identity; task version and task args; dataset identity and sample IDs; sandbox; model identity and GenerateConfig; revision origin/commit/dirty flag; package versions; and scorer definitions alongside results.
Inspect EvalConfig persists sample selection/shuffle, epochs, retry/error policy, message/token/time/cost limits and concurrency-related configuration.
Inspect EvalSample persists sample id plus epoch and a globally unique sample-run uuid, with error/retry/limit/timing/usage fields.
Inspect Dataset.Sample treats id as the sample identifier and supports deterministic seeded shuffle at the dataset layer.
Pinned Inspect has a broad dependency surface including cloud/filesystem/UI/server/tokenization packages, so full-library import is disproportionate to the narrow F2 causal-probe need.

already_stronger_in_f2: WP507 binds intervention broadcast identity/digest and matches intervention/control by probe_id plus exact nonbroadcast_input_sha256.
WP507 preserves downstream output digests and returns UNKNOWN for probe-id or nonbroadcast-input mismatch.
WP510 revalidates the WP506->WP507->WP508 object chain and concrete downstream CellOutput lineage for UPTAKEN evidence.
inspect_pattern_not_currently_structural: sample/run attempt identity and epoch/order context

newly_rejected_ambiguity.statement: Two CausalProbeArm values can share probe_id and nonbroadcast_input_sha256 yet have materially different execution/model/config/runtime conditions that are unrepresented in the arm schema. If their downstream_output_sha256 values differ, evaluate_causal_influence can classify CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE even though the difference could be caused by the unbound execution configuration rather than the broadcast intervention.
newly_rejected_ambiguity.current_schema_reason: CausalProbeArm serializes arm_id, probe_id, condition, nonbroadcast_input_sha256, downstream_output_sha256, intervention broadcast identity and opaque provenance_refs. It contains no mandatory matched_execution_context_sha256 or equivalent typed run-manifest witness.

thin_distillation.preferred_shape: One immutable ProbeExecutionContext/RunManifest object with a canonical digest shared by intervention and control, containing only the confound-critical execution identity actually required by F2.
thin_distillation.matching_rule: Intervention and control must share the same canonical execution-context digest except for the declared broadcast intervention dimension; otherwise result must be UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL.
thin_distillation.authority_fence: Run-manifest equality establishes matched experimental conditions at declared fields only. It does not prove hidden-state causality, semantic uptake, world truth, runtime success, effect correctness or whole-system acceptance.

counterhypotheses.statement: probe_id is an operational convention that already implies identical execution configuration.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Not fail-closed at current schema scope: probe_id is only a validated string and no code proves that its identity commits to runner/model/config/environment.

counterhypotheses.statement: provenance_refs can encode all execution conditions.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Possible by convention but not enforced: the schema only validates nonempty unique strings and does not require a canonical matched configuration digest shared across arms.

counterhypotheses.statement: WP510 concrete CellOutput closure makes execution-config matching unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.assessment: Rejected at mapping scope: WP510 proves output lineage to the declared F2 objects; it does not establish that intervention/control were run under identical non-intervention conditions.

dependency_and_resource_assessment.reason: Pinned Inspect depends on a broad evaluation framework surface (including cloud/filesystem, server/UI, tokenization and other general-purpose packages) that is unnecessary for a compact F2 matched-probe identity contract.
dependency_and_resource_assessment.thin_pattern_runtime_cost_hypothesis: One canonical small manifest hash plus equality check; expected negligible CPU/RAM/I/O and zero model-token/model-call cost, unmeasured until an F2 ablation.

upstream_negative_signal.current_issue: Inspect AI issue #4602 reports aggregate completed_samples can depend on scorer declaration order after scorer errors while the per-sample logs identify the same failures.
upstream_negative_signal.use: Treat as a current ecosystem warning that aggregate evaluation summaries require exact per-sample/error provenance; it is not evidence about F2 behavior and is not needed for the core E2 confound finding.

next_gate.objective: Construct an exact-current WP507 source-level fixture with matched probe_id and nonbroadcast_input_sha256 but two deliberately distinct external execution-context manifests. Show current evaluate_causal_influence still returns CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE when downstream digests differ, then show a hypothetical shared context digest rule would force UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL.
next_gate.falsifier: If exact-current WP507/WP510 already requires a canonical execution-context digest whose equality is checked across intervention/control, retire this finding as redundant.
